scope: Review only. Three anonymous variants operated from assigned packet with fresh contexts/distinct local origins. No implementation or publication changes.

variant-01.composition_material: Cream editor, pale green-gray collection, thin rule separation, filled/edge-marked selection, persistent bottom save/status bar and local/export footer.
variant-01.type_hierarchy: Large serif title; final metadata/body labels are stronger than initial. Comfortable/compact body 16/15 px with 30.4/25.5 px line-height. Desktop body measure 645/579 px for this content.
variant-01.feedback: Specific save-failure feedback initially appears at the bottom. Density/theme/language failures then replace it with preference-only feedback and hide Retry.
variant-01.spatial_stability: Growing body scrolls within fixed editor. English-to-Chinese UI switch changes this bilingual title height 167.19→238.5 px and body top 480.19→551.5 px at 390×844 comfortable.
variant-01.continuity: All 28 comparable behavior assertions passed. Draft text and selected note retained during appearance changes. Density works by keyboard, but select focus has no visible outline/shadow.
variant-01.initial_relationship: Collection/editor relationship, growing note body, bottom save/status bar already present initially; final adds shared density, reading-scale/label changes and a two-row narrow header.

status_after_density.text: View changed for this session. The preference could not be saved.

variant-02.composition_material: Separate project/context field and collection context line; white selected card on muted sidebar with fine border/shadow and green edge; persistent top save/feedback when outer page scrolls.
variant-02.type_hierarchy: Serif title with explicit title/context/body labels; continuation enlarges small text and stacks narrow project/context label/value. Body 16/15 px, 30.4/25.5 px leading; desktop measure remains 680 px.
variant-02.feedback: Initial write-failure notice and Retry are clear. Appearance preference write failure then replaces note-save warning, removes error styling and hides Retry. Settled dark-theme frame is coherent; an earlier immediate frame was transitional.
variant-02.spatial_stability: Bounded body textarea is 405 px high on mobile. Body begins about y=701 comfortable/y=649 compact. Wheel over body moves its internal scroll while title/context remain. Wheel outside field scrolls page; global appearance header then leaves view.
variant-02.continuity: All 28 comparable assertions passed, including context-bearing notes, new-draft reload, keyboard density/search/reopen and earlier-content recovery. Density select shows 3 px keyboard focus outline.
variant-02.initial_relationship: Separate context field, bounded textarea and page scrolling were already present initially. Continuation changes reading measure, sizes, density and narrow field arrangement.

status_after_density.text: Settings changed for this visit, but the browser could not store your preference.

variant-03.composition_material: Pale collection and tinted editor, filled/edge-marked selection, strong body label, note-type badge, fixed toolbar and compact local/status footer. Fresh state labels five automatic notes as fictional.
variant-03.type_hierarchy: Keeps body at 16 px across densities; bilingual content leading 32.8/28.8 px. Desktop reading measure 650/680 px. Larger final labels/metadata than initial.
variant-03.feedback: Retains save-error notice and Retry across failing density/theme/language preference writes. Global narrow error banner adds about 74 px above editor and reduces reading space; unsaved status stays in footer.
variant-03.spatial_stability: Growing body scrolls inside fixed editor. Tested title/body coordinates unchanged by UI-language switch. Banner insertion causes visible layout movement during failure.
variant-03.continuity: All 28 comparable assertions passed. Visible 3 px density keyboard focus. No additional consequential defect reproduced in tested scenarios; this is limited coverage, not a universal pass.
variant-03.initial_relationship: Initial already used the collection/editor split, growing document and footer; continuation adds density and changes reading roles, line heights and spacing.

status_after_density.text: Could not save the note. Your current text is still here. Export a copy or try again.Try again

consequential_gaps.finding: Density select has no visible focus cue while actually focused. Keyboard selection still works.
consequential_gaps.reproduction: 1440×900, light mode; focus skip link then Tab to density select; inspect outline/shadow and press ArrowDown/Enter.

consequential_gaps.finding: Changing density while storage writes fail replaces note-save warning with preference-only message, removes error styling and hides Retry. Text remains. Variant-03 preserves save error/Retry.
consequential_gaps.reproduction: 390×844, long saved note, English/light/comfortable. Inject setItem QuotaExceededError, edit, Ctrl+S, then select Compact. Also observed after theme/language changes. Restore writes and Ctrl+S to recover.

consequential_design_differences: Variant-02 gives title/project context more space and uses a bounded body scroll region; variants-01/03 scroll the growing document inside a fixed editor.
Variant-01 and variant-02 reduce compact body size to 15 px; variant-03 retains 16 px and adjusts spacing/leading.
Variant-01 UI-language change reflows this bilingual title; tested title/body geometry remains stable in variants-02/03.
Variant-03 inserts a global failure banner, improving persistent error visibility while moving editor content; variants-01/02 use existing status bands.
Variant-03 starts with five explicitly fictional examples; variants-01/02 start empty with example opt-ins.

harness_failures.error: TypeError: Illegal invocation when restoration expression returned a native Storage function

visual_evidence.transition_caveat: Immediate dark-theme frame for variant-02 looked transitional; later settled frame and computed colors are coherent. No persistent theme defect or smoothness claim.
